_README: Personal / open-source project entries. To add a project: copy the _EXAMPLE object, paste it inside the 'items' list, and edit its values. Separate entries with a comma. Optional fields you can delete if unused: client, featured, comingSoon, link, cover. IMAGES: drop an image into public/projects/ (e.g. public/projects/my-project.jpg) and set 'cover' to '/projects/my-project.jpg'. It shows at the top of the card. Leave 'cover' out and a generated placeholder is used instead. After editing, refresh the dev server (npm run dev) to see changes.

_EXAMPLE.title: Project Title
_EXAMPLE.description: One or two sentences describing what you built.

items.title: Example Open Source Tool
items.description: A small utility or library you built and open-sourced. Replace this with your real project description.

items.title: Example Personal Project
items.description: A side project you built to explore a new technology or solve a personal problem. Replace with your real project.
